      Phase 3 proof tests
        × Proof 1: Signed-out and non-member vote write denied
        × Proof 2: Vote value 2 and 0 denied on create with unchanged counters
        × Proof 3: Re-vote with same value denied
        × Proof 4: Vote create, vote delete, and suggestion counter update on archived trip denied
        × Proof 5: Signed-out, non-member and other-member reads of vote document denied
        × Proof 6a: Content update changing createdAt denied
        × Proof 6b: Content update changing authorId denied (1 ms)
        × Proof 6c: Content update changing status denied
        × Proof 6d: Content update changing dayIndex denied
        × Proof 6e: Content update changing order denied
        × Proof 7: Suggestion delete denied for non-member and signed-out user
        × Proof 8a: Plain suggestion counter update with NO vote change denied
        × Proof 8b: Vote write with NO matching counter change denied
      Phase 4 itinerary rules
        × Organizer schedules pending suggestion to scheduled (day 0 and last day)
        × Organizer reorders, moves day, and unschedules
        × Scheduling denied for plain member, non-organizer author, non-member, signed out, archived trip
        × Denied scheduling for invalid dayIndex, order, status values, coherence, and extra/mixed keys
        × Existing content-update and counter branches cannot set scheduling fields, and vote transaction works on scheduled item
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 0 (1-day trip) allows dayIndex 0, denies 1
        × Day bound tolerance: diff exactly 2 days allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 47 hours (spring-forward) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 49 hours (fall-back) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 30 days allows 30, denies 31
      Phase 5 expense rules
        × Valid create: payer is creator, payer is another member, subset, all 15 participants
        × Create denied for signed out and non-member
        × Create denied when createdBy is not the caller (1 ms)
        × Create denied for extra key or missing key
        × Create denied for invalid amount (0, negative, float, string, over cap)
        × Create denied for invalid description (empty, >100 chars, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid paidBy (not a member, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid participantIds (empty, 16 elements, non-member, duplicates, non-list, non-strings)
        × Create denied when date is not a timestamp or createdAt is a client date
        × Create denied on archived trip
        × Update: creator and organizer succeed; other member and non-member denied
        × Update denied when changing createdBy or createdAt
        × Update denied for invalid resulting values (amount, description, paidBy, participantIds, date)
        × Update denied on archived trip
        × Delete: creator and organizer succeed; other member, non-member, signed out, and archived denied
        × Read: member succeeds; non-member and signed out denied
      Phase 6: Settlements & Leaving a Trip Security Rules
        × Trip members can read settlements, non-members cannot
        × Valid settlement create succeeds by payer, fails for invalid fields, amounts, or non-members
        × Settlement resolve succeeds for receiver or organizer (non-payer), fails for unauthorized or self-confirm by organizer
        × Payer can cancel pending settlement via delete
        × Member leaves successfully (batch update + member status left)
        × Organizer removes member successfully
        × Plain member cannot remove another member
        × Cannot remove the organizer (including organizer leaving)
        × Padding attack denial - cannot add uid while removing
        × Padding attack denial - removing two uids at once
        × memberCount must decrease by exactly 1
        × Cannot change other trip fields during leave/remove
        × Cannot leave/remove from archived trip
        × Non-member cannot leave/remove
        × Signed-out user cannot leave/remove
        × Marking status "left" WITHOUT removing uid from memberIds is denied
        × Removing uid from memberIds WITHOUT marking status "left" is denied
        × members/{uid} updates changing keys other than status are denied

      Phase 4 itinerary rules
        × Organizer schedules pending suggestion to scheduled (day 0 and last day)
        × Organizer reorders, moves day, and unschedules
        × Scheduling denied for plain member, non-organizer author, non-member, signed out, archived trip
        × Denied scheduling for invalid dayIndex, order, status values, coherence, and extra/mixed keys
        × Existing content-update and counter branches cannot set scheduling fields, and vote transaction works on scheduled item
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 0 (1-day trip) allows dayIndex 0, denies 1
        × Day bound tolerance: diff exactly 2 days allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 47 hours (spring-forward) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 49 hours (fall-back) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 30 days allows 30, denies 31 (1 ms)
      Phase 5 expense rules
        × Valid create: payer is creator, payer is another member, subset, all 15 participants
        × Create denied for signed out and non-member
        × Create denied when createdBy is not the caller
        × Create denied for extra key or missing key
        × Create denied for invalid amount (0, negative, float, string, over cap)
        × Create denied for invalid description (empty, >100 chars, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid paidBy (not a member, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid participantIds (empty, 16 elements, non-member, duplicates, non-list, non-strings)
        × Create denied when date is not a timestamp or createdAt is a client date
        × Create denied on archived trip
        × Update: creator and organizer succeed; other member and non-member denied (1 ms)
        × Update denied when changing createdBy or createdAt
        × Update denied for invalid resulting values (amount, description, paidBy, participantIds, date)
        × Update denied on archived trip
        × Delete: creator and organizer succeed; other member, non-member, signed out, and archived denied
        × Read: member succeeds; non-member and signed out denied
      Phase 6: Settlements & Leaving a Trip Security Rules
        × Trip members can read settlements, non-members cannot
        × Valid settlement create succeeds by payer, fails for invalid fields, amounts, or non-members
        × Settlement resolve succeeds for receiver or organizer (non-payer), fails for unauthorized or self-confirm by organizer
        × Payer can cancel pending settlement via delete
        × Member leaves successfully (batch update + member status left)
        × Organizer removes member successfully
        × Plain member cannot remove another member
        × Cannot remove the organizer (including organizer leaving)
        × Padding attack denial - cannot add uid while removing
        × Padding attack denial - removing two uids at once
        × memberCount must decrease by exactly 1
        × Cannot change other trip fields during leave/remove
        × Cannot leave/remove from archived trip
        × Non-member cannot leave/remove
        × Signed-out user cannot leave/remove
        × Marking status "left" WITHOUT removing uid from memberIds is denied
        × Removing uid from memberIds WITHOUT marking status "left" is denied
        × members/{uid} updates changing keys other than status are denied

        × Proof 6d: Content update changing dayIndex denied
        × Proof 6e: Content update changing order denied
        × Proof 7: Suggestion delete denied for non-member and signed-out user
        × Proof 8a: Plain suggestion counter update with NO vote change denied
        × Proof 8b: Vote write with NO matching counter change denied
      Phase 4 itinerary rules
        × Organizer schedules pending suggestion to scheduled (day 0 and last day)
        × Organizer reorders, moves day, and unschedules (1 ms)
        × Scheduling denied for plain member, non-organizer author, non-member, signed out, archived trip
        × Denied scheduling for invalid dayIndex, order, status values, coherence, and extra/mixed keys
        × Existing content-update and counter branches cannot set scheduling fields, and vote transaction works on scheduled item
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 0 (1-day trip) allows dayIndex 0, denies 1
        × Day bound tolerance: diff exactly 2 days allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 47 hours (spring-forward) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 49 hours (fall-back) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 30 days allows 30, denies 31
      Phase 5 expense rules
        × Valid create: payer is creator, payer is another member, subset, all 15 participants
        × Create denied for signed out and non-member
        × Create denied when createdBy is not the caller
        × Create denied for extra key or missing key
        × Create denied for invalid amount (0, negative, float, string, over cap)
        × Create denied for invalid description (empty, >100 chars, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid paidBy (not a member, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid participantIds (empty, 16 elements, non-member, duplicates, non-list, non-strings)
        × Create denied when date is not a timestamp or createdAt is a client date
        × Create denied on archived trip
        × Update: creator and organizer succeed; other member and non-member denied
        × Update denied when changing createdBy or createdAt
        × Update denied for invalid resulting values (amount, description, paidBy, participantIds, date)
        × Update denied on archived trip
        × Delete: creator and organizer succeed; other member, non-member, signed out, and archived denied
        × Read: member succeeds; non-member and signed out denied (1 ms)
      Phase 6: Settlements & Leaving a Trip Security Rules
        × Trip members can read settlements, non-members cannot
        × Valid settlement create succeeds by payer, fails for invalid fields, amounts, or non-members
        × Settlement resolve succeeds for receiver or organizer (non-payer), fails for unauthorized or self-confirm by organizer
        × Payer can cancel pending settlement via delete
        × Member leaves successfully (batch update + member status left)
        × Organizer removes member successfully
        × Plain member cannot remove another member
        × Cannot remove the organizer (including organizer leaving)
        × Padding attack denial - cannot add uid while removing (1 ms)
        × Padding attack denial - removing two uids at once
        × memberCount must decrease by exactly 1
        × Cannot change other trip fields during leave/remove
        × Cannot leave/remove from archived trip
        × Non-member cannot leave/remove
        × Signed-out user cannot leave/remove
        × Marking status "left" WITHOUT removing uid from memberIds is denied
        × Removing uid from memberIds WITHOUT marking status "left" is denied
        × members/{uid} updates changing keys other than status are denied

        × Day bound tolerance: diff 47 hours (spring-forward) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 49 hours (fall-back) allows 2, denies 3
        × Day bound tolerance: diff 30 days allows 30, denies 31
      Phase 5 expense rules
        × Valid create: payer is creator, payer is another member, subset, all 15 participants
        × Create denied for signed out and non-member
        × Create denied when createdBy is not the caller
        × Create denied for extra key or missing key
        × Create denied for invalid amount (0, negative, float, string, over cap)
        × Create denied for invalid description (empty, >100 chars, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid paidBy (not a member, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid participantIds (empty, 16 elements, non-member, duplicates, non-list, non-strings)
        × Create denied when date is not a timestamp or createdAt is a client date
        × Create denied on archived trip (1 ms)
        × Update: creator and organizer succeed; other member and non-member denied
        × Update denied when changing createdBy or createdAt
        × Update denied for invalid resulting values (amount, description, paidBy, participantIds, date)
        × Update denied on archived trip
        × Delete: creator and organizer succeed; other member, non-member, signed out, and archived denied
        × Read: member succeeds; non-member and signed out denied
      Phase 6: Settlements & Leaving a Trip Security Rules
        × Trip members can read settlements, non-members cannot
        × Valid settlement create succeeds by payer, fails for invalid fields, amounts, or non-members
        × Settlement resolve succeeds for receiver or organizer (non-payer), fails for unauthorized or self-confirm by organizer
        × Payer can cancel pending settlement via delete
        × Member leaves successfully (batch update + member status left)
        × Organizer removes member successfully
        × Plain member cannot remove another member
        × Cannot remove the organizer (including organizer leaving) (1 ms)
        × Padding attack denial - cannot add uid while removing
        × Padding attack denial - removing two uids at once
        × memberCount must decrease by exactly 1
        × Cannot change other trip fields during leave/remove
        × Cannot leave/remove from archived trip
        × Non-member cannot leave/remove
        × Signed-out user cannot leave/remove (1 ms)
        × Marking status "left" WITHOUT removing uid from memberIds is denied (1 ms)
        × Removing uid from memberIds WITHOUT marking status "left" is denied
        × members/{uid} updates changing keys other than status are denied

        × Create denied for invalid description (empty, >100 chars, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid paidBy (not a member, non-string)
        × Create denied for invalid participantIds (empty, 16 elements, non-member, duplicates, non-list, non-strings)
        × Create denied when date is not a timestamp or createdAt is a client date
        × Create denied on archived trip
        × Update: creator and organizer succeed; other member and non-member denied
        × Update denied when changing createdBy or createdAt
        × Update denied for invalid resulting values (amount, description, paidBy, participantIds, date)
        × Update denied on archived trip
        × Delete: creator and organizer succeed; other member, non-member, signed out, and archived denied
        × Read: member succeeds; non-member and signed out denied
      Phase 6: Settlements & Leaving a Trip Security Rules
        × Trip members can read settlements, non-members cannot (1 ms)
        × Valid settlement create succeeds by payer, fails for invalid fields, amounts, or non-members
        × Settlement resolve succeeds for receiver or organizer (non-payer), fails for unauthorized or self-confirm by organizer
        × Payer can cancel pending settlement via delete
        × Member leaves successfully (batch update + member status left)
        × Organizer removes member successfully
        × Plain member cannot remove another member
        × Cannot remove the organizer (including organizer leaving)
        × Padding attack denial - cannot add uid while removing
        × Padding attack denial - removing two uids at once
        × memberCount must decrease by exactly 1
        × Cannot change other trip fields during leave/remove
        × Cannot leave/remove from archived trip
        × Non-member cannot leave/remove
        × Signed-out user cannot leave/remove
        × Marking status "left" WITHOUT removing uid from memberIds is denied
        × Removing uid from memberIds WITHOUT marking status "left" is denied
        × members/{uid} updates changing keys other than status are denied
